sloka: विसृजास्मै वधाय त्वमस्त्रं पैतामहं प्रभो ।विनाशकालः कथितो यः सुरैः सो ऽद्य वर्तत ।। ६.१११.२ ।।
transliteration: visṛjāsmai vadhāya tvamastraṁ paitāmahaṁ prabho ।vināśakālaḥ kathito yaḥ suraiḥ so 'dya vartata ।। 6.111.2 ।।

translations.english: "O king! As spoken by Suras, the destruction of Ravana has come now. Use the missile of the creator Brahma."
